steps.speaker: Single-eyed Puppet
steps.content: Hehehe... Hahaha... Useless... It's useless... Its voice has already spread. You cannot resist it.

steps.speaker: Single-eyed Puppet
steps.content: Thoughts bring fear. Fear brings hatred. And when you infect each other...

steps.speaker: Single-eyed Puppet
steps.content: You desire to follow. Follow the strong ones. Follow the crowd. If you can't do that, you follow the darkness within you... Lowlifes, mere ants... This is your true nature...
Bang bang! Bang!
That strange man falls down with the gunshots, but it isn't you who killed him.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: It's you guys again...
The shooter is Lavina, a version of her that's entirely strange to you. Her red hair falls loosely and flies up again, as if soaked in blood, blazing. Like a devil returning from hell.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Lavina? What happened to you...?

steps.speaker: Panicking Crowd
steps.content: Murderer... She killed a man...

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: That's right. Rustfire is finally pointing their guns at us... She's been wanting to do that...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Who else... I know you're not alone... I know you'll come back...
She shifts her gun to the crowd, passing every terrified face, each pause eliciting a beseeching cry. But Lavina is unbothered. Her once gentle, sad eyes were now filled only with furious malice.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: Hehehe... Hahaha... Look, look! This is what they want. We'll all die for nothing...

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: <size=44>Show yourself!!!</size>
You rush over. She aims the gun at you reflexively, but Hella scurries to her from the other side and pushes her onto the ground. You pry her gun-holding hand open instantly.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Let me go! I want to kill it, I want to kill them!
She has shockingly powerful strength, and the unbridled emotions keep stimulating your nerves. The pain reaches your soul through the shackles.
...It's Mania!
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: My kid was about your age when she left.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I didn't lose anyone else, and it's all thanks to you. Regardless of what the others say, I'm... <size=40>truly grateful</size> to you.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Let go!

steps.speaker: Hopeful Voice
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>Mom?</color>

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Ahhh!

Light impales her body and cleaves through her consciousness. As if her soul has been drained from her, Lavina lets go. The gun falls to the ground as she falls into Hella's arms. Meanwhile, Rustfire members have finally contained the situation.
You're gasping for air. Your mind begins to lose focus, one second blur and the next clear. Loaded with intense emotions, broken scenes gradually seep into your mind.

steps.speaker: (Flashback)
steps.content: (Flashback)
Someone is staggering toward a girl. She's frail and seems terrified.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Go away, please go away, don't...
Sinner...
Come with me... Your power... Need... your...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Back off!!
She picks up the suona and blows out ear-splitting sound waves, piercing through that person before her. The person falls down.
Come back... with me... Rustfire... wants to save you... Rustfire wants to... protect you.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Sob... Sorry... Sorry...

steps.speaker: (Flashback)
steps.content: (Flashback)
Next to the broken bridge, K.K. is gripping someone's hand tightly.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Don't let go. I still owe you money, remember? I'll pay you back. Hang in there, don't give up. Haven't you been chasing me for the money? Hold on to me... Ahh!!!
Something tumbles down suddenly and hits K.K.'s shoulder. Her hand loosens, and the last thing she hears is a painful cry.

steps.speaker: (Flashback)
steps.content: (Flashback)
The vagabond Outland doctor is stuck in the dark alley, tending to the injured in turn. His face is covered in sad tears, either due to shock or misery.

An amnesiac old woman has just been saved from danger. After bringing her to Rustfire, the man risking his life to save her goes back to rescue more people. He keeps coming back, until finally he doesn't.

Struggle, bitterness, obsession, longing... Emotions are boiling in this place where tens of thousands of people gather. A wicked, filthy monster who only dares to hide in the dark corner sets them ablaze like firewood, then gobbles them down.
Lava-like scorch marks are gradually smeared all over the Drifter Camp. The shackles intensify, waking the fear in the deepest part of your soul that you desperately want to forget.
(Scene change)
...Powerlessness. Just like what she once taught you. You're still alive, but you feel dead. All you can do is watch, unable to accept or stop anything. You're being ripped apart by despair, and...
Ignited by rage.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has launched the evacuation procedures. All inhabitants please follow Rustfire members to the shelters.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Keep calm. Stay rational. Support each other. We've overcome countless hardships before, and we'll do it again this time. I repeat...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go with Rustfire. They'll escort you out. Once you're out, look for an external communications device and contact Nightingale, and tell her about the situation here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to protect those who've escaped. Do your best to hold off the Executive Committee. You can even call the 9th Agency. Anyways, don't let the Executive Committee get involved. Ask the FAC to take over the potential Black Ring zone.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hold on, if we are leaving, what about you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Judging from this Corpseborne's behavior, it's quite cowardly and prudent. It fears death, fears a certain entity that killed it. That's why it must hide, until it takes back its own Black Ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once its Black Ring returns, the shackles will be strong enough to protect me.
You look at the two deeply.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I can't do this on my own. Please help me.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... can't. My order is to protect you.
Hecate is obviously troubled, struggling with the urge to refuse. You turn to Hella to find her face full of anxiety and hesitation. At last, she asks.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Asking for aid will help you more than just the three of us trying to deal with this alone. Is that what you mean?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I got it.
Gritting her teeth, the girl carries Lavina with one arm and hauls Hecate up with the other.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, Hecate. The sooner we're done, the sooner we can come back. There's nothing else we can do here besides wasting our time panicking.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't want to see another Black Ring again. I'm sick of watching people die and not being able to help.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let me go, I have to...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't you want to help him? Then just listen to him one more time. You've always trusted him.
steps.female_content: Don't you want to help her? Then just listen to her one more time. You've always trusted her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: By the way, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't do anything stupid alone! Wait for us, you hear me?
Of course, it's a lie.
In the end, Hella drags Hecate away hurriedly. You watch them disappear in the disorderly structures of the Drifter Camp, then turn back to go up.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has launched the evacuation procedures. All inhabitants please follow Rustfire members to the shelters.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Keep calm. Stay rational. Support each other. We've overcome countless hardships before, and we'll do it again this time. I repeat...

You stagger upward. Black crows cover the sky, reeking of death. The shackles' power is surging rapidly. Mania is leaking. The Black Ring is hatching. On the path ahead of you, a crowd of Corruptors is stumbling toward you.
Your power is charging. Suddenly, you hear a familiar voice behind you.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Leave them to me. You can't take so many of them. You'll get yourself killed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I sent them away for their safety. I'm not planning to die.
The shackles that have once touched death now sense that familiar, despicable presence faintly, feeling it becomes stronger. It's right above and will eventually get close to you.
...You won't be defeated by such a detestable creature. You'll find it, trace its path of awakening, and wreck it completely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought you left? Why did you...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I took Che somewhere safe. I thought about it, and decided to come back.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I'm tired of feeling useless. If those two decide to keep their mouths shut, then I'll look for the answer myself.
